upgrades.name: Window Herb Boxes
upgrades.description: Adds a lived-in daytime look and improves walk-in appeal.
upgrades.description_zh: 让白天门面更有生活感，并提升路过客流的吸引力。

upgrades.name: Second Stock Pot
upgrades.description: Raises kitchen throughput for heavier lunch menus.
upgrades.description_zh: 提高后厨吞吐量，更适合支撑份量更重的午市菜单。

upgrades.name: Counter Runner
upgrades.description: Keeps orders moving and cushions complex menus.
upgrades.description_zh: 让订单流转更顺，也能缓冲复杂菜单带来的压力。

upgrades.name: Night Specials Board
upgrades.description: Unlocks future service hooks for night-only dishes.
upgrades.description_zh: 解锁只在夜间食材路线中才会出现的后续营业钩子。
